args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the docstring and the tests in `tests/test_money.py` (per FIN-212) expect banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode in `src/money.py` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- No test changes required — the existing tests now pass:
  - `2.665` → `2.66` (ties-to-even)
  - `2.675` → `2.68`

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` (sha `08d3cd5986`) passed.
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
